A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete 25-page versions of the same ActSafe paper, including Appendices A-C. Text and rendered-page inspection support direct comparison of the equations, figures, tables, and appendices.

before.justification: v2 reports original reinforcement-learning experiments in Section 5 and Appendix C, including reward, safety-cost, ablation, and dynamics-shift results.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and their reported outcomes, including GP control, visual control, and HumanoidBench evaluations.

M1.justification: Algorithms 1-2, the exploration and exploitation objectives, pessimistic safety constraints, and GP/RSSM implementations are unchanged. The correction to Assumption 4.5 does not alter the proposed procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same Pendulum/Cartpole tasks, dense and sparse Safety-Gym tasks, RWRL Cartpole, DOGGO, shifted-dynamics scenarios, and HumanoidBench POLE task. Appendix coverage is unchanged.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain their comparator sets, including OPAX, LAMBDA, CPO, BSRP-LAG, GREEDY, UNIFORM, OPTIMISTIC, and the same ActSafe ablation variants. The deleted citation in Section 4.3 does not remove an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendices B-C retain the same metrics, training budgets, episode lengths, 200K-step visual-control warm-up, 50-episode evaluation procedure, and dynamics-shift protocols.

E4.justification: The pessimism ablation in Figure 3, optimizer ablation in Figure 9, dynamics-shift analysis in Figure 10, and OPAX exploration-budget comparison in Figure 12 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Figure 4 still reports means and standard errors over 10 seeds. Appendix B.2 retains five seeds by default and median/standard-error reporting. No repeated-run or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: The experimental plots and accompanying findings in Section 5 and Appendix C are identical. No numerical results, rankings, trends, or qualitative outcomes are added, removed, or revised.

T1.justification: Assumption 4.5 changes the kernel bound from k(s,s) <= sigma_max for states s in S to k(z,z) <= sigma_max for state-action pairs z in Z. This corrects the formal domain to match Definition 4.4. Theorem 4.8 and all Appendix A proofs remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about safe exploration, finite-sample near-optimality under assumptions, scalability to visual control, and empirical performance.

C2.justification: The explanations of conservatism versus reward, initial calibration requirements, LBSGD's unmet unbiasedness assumption, and simulator-fidelity/pessimism tradeoffs are unchanged in Section 5 and Appendix C.

D1.justification: Implementation details, reward and cost definitions, model size, ensemble and planner descriptions, and the code-access statement are unchanged. The added funding acknowledgment supplies no new reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Section 4.3 removes Sukhija et al. (2023), GoSafeOpt, from the examples credited with a similar safe-set relaxation, retaining Berkenkamp et al. (2021) and Baumann et al. (2021). GoSafeOpt remains cited elsewhere and in the bibliography; broader positioning is unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 corrects 'n-the' and 'Furterhmore', restores a missing closing brace in Assumption 4.5, and adds an ELSA/EU funding acknowledgment for Bhavya Sukhija. Section order and the overall narrative remain unchanged.

P2.justification: All 12 figures and Table 1 retain their content, design, and placement. The expanded acknowledgment shifts and compresses reference spacing on page 11; other visual edits are limited to local text reflow and the updated arXiv margin stamp.

improvement.justification: v3 improves mathematical precision by correcting Assumption 4.5's kernel-bound domain to the state-action space already used by the dynamics model. Local typographical repairs add clarity. These are limited improvements: the methods, empirical evidence, main claims, and appendix proofs remain unchanged.
